resources.string: Do Not Disturb access is needed so tapping a tag can silence notifications. Nothing works without it.
Pick which tag to program, then hold it against the back of the phone. Label the tags — they look identical.
Ready — hold a tag against the phone.
this tag is locked and cannot be rewritten
this tag does not support NDEF
Running for %1$s — not counted below until you tap.
Closes automatically in %1$s if you forget.
Past the auto-close time — closing shortly.
Close the session automatically if the second tap is forgotten. Zero in both boxes turns this off.
Sessions close automatically %1$s after they start.
Sessions never close automatically. Forgetting the second tap leaves the phone silenced.
Study mode ended automatically — you forgot the second tap
%1$s of %2$s recorded. Tap the STUDY tag again if you are still studying.
Tap the STUDY tag again if you are still studying.
Rings when a study session is closed for you because the second tap was forgotten.
Alarm when a session closes itself: on.
Allow notifications so an alarm sounds when a session closes itself. Without it the session still closes quietly.
This phone has no notification settings screen to open.
No study time recorded yet. Tap the STUDY tag to start.
Some of this was closed automatically, so those hours are a cap rather than a measurement.
Study mode is off — tap the STUDY tag first
Could not change Do Not Disturb — open Study Tracker and grant access
NFC is switched off. Turn it on in Settings, then come back.
